manwe_probe.note: The 32-token exact-output probe completed through Manwe but ended at the token cap while emitting model thinking text; inference and route selection are proven, exact instruction compliance is not.

verification.command: cargo test -p arda-engine --test worker_orchestrator --test orome_smoke --test run_recovery --test hermes_adapter_contract
cargo test -p arda-aule --features full-cli --test ceo_surface --test autopilot_surface

components.responsibility: root composition, service registry, harness, supervision, durable runs
gaps: With --no-ui the root supervises only Manwe; Varda, metrics, Crawl4AI, RELIC, Hermes, and CEO run under separate lifecycle owners.
Harness status lists configured launcher/HUD names but only returns a live Manwe service status.
components.alignment: Retain as autonomic/root spine; make enrolled-node and external-service topology explicit rather than implying all organism organs are supervised children.

components.responsibility: task, capability composition, project/run graph, service, next-action, and operator contracts
gaps: No accepted organism manifest/context capsule yet.
Core also contains a competing persistent Oromë agent/router state family.
components.alignment: Extend existing task/run/capability authorities; do not add another organism-contract crate.

components.responsibility: deterministic policy, authority, evidence, human-impact, readiness, and metrics
gaps: The crate explicitly does not own autonomous enforcement; all organism execution paths must prove they call its owning gates.
components.alignment: Keep as semantic authority classifier; model/council confidence cannot override it.

components.responsibility: worker scheduling, budgets, recovery, cancellation, Hermes execution receipts
gaps: Current worker route classes are deterministic/local/hosted/human, not enrolled node identities.
Ordinary Hermes delegate_task children are outside canonical Arda run/receipt lineage.
components.alignment: Reuse durable run and receipt machinery; extend placement to node/A2A lifetimes without replacing the adapter.

components.responsibility: normalized operator ingress, provider dispatch, transport outcome and approval lineage
gaps: Default provider smoke uses ManualTransport; concrete network delivery requires separately configured transports.
Delivery fields in historical operator-session rows remain pending and are not platform-delivery proof.
components.alignment: Keep semantic ingress and outcome receipts; platform credentials/callbacks stay with Hermes.

components.responsibility: A2A message type, TTL, reply/thread lineage, signatures and hops
gaps: No root consumer sends these envelopes across a process/machine boundary.
No Linux Foundation A2A codec or Agent Card mapping exists.
components.alignment: Retain as candidate internal semantic envelope and map it onto standard Hermes/Linux Foundation A2A transport.

components.responsibility: agent identity, capability lookup, heartbeat, message routing and queueing
gaps: Oromë registry is in-memory and only compiled for tests/service-runtime.
Oromë MessageRouter is test-only.
Core has a second persistent AgentRegistry and RouterState whose shared router returns a Placeholder.
Prometheus parses a third roster from stale world.json.
components.alignment: Stage 0 authority mapping must select one semantic node/agent registry and standard A2A transport before promotion; no deletion in Task 1.

components.responsibility: conversation, sessions, gateway, tools, skills, delegation, profiles and authenticated Arda ingress
gaps: A2A toolset is disabled.
Only the default profile exists.
The plugin registers only pre_gateway_dispatch and emits no subagent lifecycle/placement receipts.
Hermes is 42 upstream commits behind.
components.alignment: Reuse as cognitive/session runtime; extend the existing plugin through public lifecycle/A2A surfaces instead of forking Hermes.

components.responsibility: provider/model routing, route health, capability catalog and inference receipts
gaps: Catalog advertisement includes unreachable active backbone routes.
Placement is provider/model-centric and does not yet consume a canonical expiring node-capability contract.
components.alignment: Keep model/provider authority; join it with node identity and resource evidence rather than moving placement into CEO or Hermes.

components.responsibility: canonical memory, governed knowledge, continuity, scope policy and persona/context projection
gaps: No organism context capsule or memory-use receipt is yet composed into generic worker bootstrap.
Hermes profile memory remains a separate conversational store that needs an explicit non-authority boundary.
components.alignment: Make Vairë the capsule and collective-continuity owner; do not create another context database.

components.responsibility: ingest, query, deep analysis, external evaluation, evidence and research briefs
gaps: The separate Varda listener returns 404 at /health; systemd asserts process state but no service-specific readiness URL is configured.
Current operator projection contains a pending research run with no workers despite completed evidence artifacts.
components.alignment: Reuse evidence authority; repair service readiness and reconcile run/evidence terminal state.

components.responsibility: bounded project inventory, evidence normalization, comparison and review-only organization plans
gaps: Library is invoked on demand; no organism-level scheduled role or node placement contract exists.
components.alignment: Keep review-only audit role and expose it as a bounded capability, not a sovereign autonomous agent.

components.responsibility: bounded reasoning/evidence confidence and policy verdicts
gaps: Legacy Oracle naming persists in source docs/types.
Reasoning is a library capability rather than a live node/role.
components.alignment: Use as evidence/verdict capability inside composition; do not expose it as a competing planner.

components.responsibility: cost, energy, JouleWork, measurement provenance and budgets
gaps: Worker scheduling reserves configured budgets, but current placement does not join measured node pressure/energy observations.
Observed versus estimated cost must remain explicit.
components.alignment: Keep metabolism/resource accounting and connect measured node observations during Stage 3/5.

components.responsibility: metrics, operator telemetry, presence and read-only projections
gaps: CEO/Prometheus modules are not in the default/root compile surface; only basic observability/presence is.
Operator projection currently shows no service/capability rows while harness status has Manwe.
components.alignment: Retain projection/telemetry owner; converge projections on direct topology and receipt evidence.

components.responsibility: read-only objective selection, planner, council, queue analysis, recommendations and executive loop
gaps: Runs as a separate timer-backed full-cli process, not the root runtime.
Current decision is hold; no objective selected and no plans/outcomes processed.
CoreAutonomyProfile expects core/realm/boot.toml, which is absent; copies exist under core/knowledge/realm.
core/state/world.json contains a March Arandur heartbeat yet labels Arandur ONLINE and system READY.
No data/arandur recommendation tree exists.
components.alignment: Unify around current queue/topology/context/receipts; retire stale world/realm projections as current authority after successor proof.

components.responsibility: node inventory, enrollment, observations, presence, research and device boundaries
gaps: Fleet TOML is configuration, not an expiring canonical node observation registry.
Three configured active targets currently time out.
Capability fields are primarily inference-specific and do not yet advertise general tools/data/privacy/resource state.
components.alignment: Reuse enrollment/observation/presence contracts; converge one node manifest and fresh observation model.

components.responsibility: bounded remote research/audit/recall and advisory observations
gaps: Reachable as a bounded proxy/outpost, not enrolled as a generic A2A worker.
Advisory authority is intentionally execution-prohibited.
components.alignment: Use as first remote evidence node in Stage 2 while preserving advisory-only authority.

components.responsibility: read-only receipt-backed runtime-presence validation and projection
gaps: CITADEL endpoint currently times out.
No current physical delivery acknowledgement file exists.
Active scp retries prove attempted transfer, not delivery.
components.alignment: Keep read-only projection, but hold embodiment acceptance until living-mesh receipts and fresh delivery acknowledgement exist.

components.responsibility: declared contract tracks, schemas, sources, receipts and CLI verbs
gaps: Direct consumers are launcher/onboarding and CLI validation, not root execution.
Registry generated_at is July 31 and contains maturity/CLI/source claims that need current live audit before reuse.
The root workspace declares the dependency alias but root/engine do not consume it.
components.alignment: Reuse loader/validation; regenerate tracks from accepted authority map and wire root admission only after Stage 1 design.

components.responsibility: append-only operator/project task authority and read-only active/summary views
gaps: Generated active projection counts dependency-gated plan tasks as active backlog.
Projection drops origin/scope/meta needed to explain dependency gates.
Next-action and Arandur separately exclude all 12 tasks, producing inconsistent meaning of active.
components.alignment: Keep JSONL canonical and append-only; change projection semantics/fields rather than adding a new queue.

components.responsibility: human-visible objective/run/capability/service/receipt convergence
gaps: Current fresh projection reports one pending economic-intelligence run with no workers, zero capabilities, and no services while harness runtime shows Manwe and separate services.
Current source-backed research evidence and run terminal state are not reconciled.
components.alignment: Make this the eventual coherent organism projection only after topology, work, and outcome sources reconcile.

components.responsibility: legacy agent roster and world readiness projection
gaps: world.json labels Arandur ONLINE/READY using a March heartbeat and is stale.
CoreAutonomyProfile reads absent core/realm paths while historical copies live under core/knowledge/realm.
components.alignment: Do not delete in Task 1. Stage 0 authority mapping must name the live topology/identity successor and prove no required consumers before retirement.

components.responsibility: operator workstations, native projections and eventual embodiment
gaps: Root runs --no-ui; launcher/HUD are not supervised in the live root process.
Mirromere remains intentionally held and must not become a Hermes dashboard or topology fiction.
Existing unrelated HUD work is dirty and was excluded from Task 1.
components.alignment: Consume future organism projection; do not mint topology, work, health or approval.

blocking_decisions: Select one semantic node/agent registry and its persistence owner.
Define Arda semantic envelope to Hermes/Linux Foundation A2A mapping.
Replace stale world/realm identity projections only after successor proof.
Trace one current objective end to end in Task 2 before contract implementation.
